4) The patentee and every licensee shall furnish a statement as to the 
extent to which the patented invention has been worked on a 
commercial scale in India, in Form 27, in respect of every calendar 
year, within three months of the end of each year.

11.06 Amendments after the grant of patents 
1) After the grant of patent, the patentee may apply for an amendment 
of the application for patent, complete specification or any 
document relating thereto subject to such conditions, if 
any, and as the Controller thinks fit. Such a request may be filed in 
Form-13 with the prescribed fee.
